pages.text_en: Warning! The mega tornado is coming. It will last for one month. A mega tornado? We need a shelter immediately. We have to build a doomsday bunker deep underground. Leave the digging to me. I have the boom-boom blocks.

A mega tornado? We need a shelter immediately.
We have to build a doomsday bunker deep underground.
Leave the digging to me. I have the boom-boom blocks.

pages.text_en: Make sure it's deep enough so the house doesn't fall on us. Fire in the hole! A perfect square room. I am an artist. Good job. Now let's furnish it before the storm hits. Kitchen, beds, bathroom. It is perfect.

pages.text_en: And most importantly, the gaming corner. We can't survive a month without video games. Hurry everyone. Get inside. The storm is starting. Don't push. There is room for everyone.

pages.text_en: Mikey, the fridge is empty. We had enough food for a month. I got nervous. When I get nervous, I eat. We are going to starve. We have to go to the surface and find the village food pantry. Outside? In the tornado? But I just washed my shell.

pages.text_en: Oh no. The village is destroyed. It looks like my room after I clean it. Stay low, Mikey. Don't let the wind grab you.

pages.text_en: Ow! Focus. The food pantry is that obsidian building over there. Ha! My shell is storm proof. Keep moving. We are almost there.

pages.text_en: The food pantry is made of obsidian. It survived the storm. Grab everything we can carry. I got the potatoes and the rotten flesh. Wait. You. Not the rotten flesh.

pages.text_en: On Mikey, it's right behind us. My short turtle legs are moving as fast as they can. Get in. Whoa.
